Your first little program

1.New Project

  1. Choose an offline template to create a new DSL Mini Program project
  2. Or choose an online template to create a new H5 Mini Program project (After downloading the H5 online template, it still needs to be converted by a converter to be used normally)

Steps

  1. Click New Project.
  2. Enter the project name.
  3. Select the Mini Program directory.
  4. Create a new Mini Program and select a template.
  5. Complete the creation.

Create a Hello World Mini Program by default.

2.Viewing Development Documents

Understand the use of components and APIs

3.Simulator Installation

By default, the plug-in does not have a built-in simulator and needs to be installed.

  1. Find the simulator package Macle_xx.x.x_DevSuite_Simulator.zip in the download page. The package contains the simulator files of the two operating systems.

  2. Select an installation mode. Currently, there are two installation modes: automatic import and manual installation. For details about automatic installation, see Import Offline Simulator. The manual installation procedure is as follows:

    1. For Windows users, use Macle_xx.x.x_DevSuite_Simulator_Win.zip

      For Mac OS users, use Macle_xx.x.x_DevSuite_Simulator_Mac.zip

    2. Download the IDE plug-in and install it. > Download the simulator package. > Decompress the package. > Decompress the package and save the package to the specified directory. > Switch back to the development page and use the simulator.

      The simulator directory is usually as follows:

      Windows: %vscode user directory%\.vscode\extensions\macleteam.macle-miniprogram-tools-xx.x.x\src\utils\simulator\windows

      Mac OS: ~/.vscode/extensions/macleteam.macle-miniprogram-tools-xx.x.x/src/utils/simulator/mac

    3. The installation is complete.

4.Open the simulator and preview it in real time.

5.Edit and save the code and view the compilation result.

6.Quickly create a page or component

You can right-click the pages folder of the project file and choose New Component and Page from the shortcut menu to quickly build the project structure.
